title: Flank steak rice bowls with Japanese BBQ sauce and roasted broccoli
equipment: Large cast iron skillet + sheet pan
ingredients: Japanese BBQ sauce, for drizzling (sugary, so go light)
(4) broccoli crowns, about 2 lb, cut in florets

steps.do: Heat the oven to 425°F and start the rice cooker.
Toss the broccoli with oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan and roast about 20 minutes, until browned at the edges.

Meanwhile pat the steak dry, cut it in half to fit the pan, and season both sides with salt and pepper. Sear in a very hot oiled skillet 4 to 5 minutes per side, one half at a time, to 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest the steak 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.
Build bowls with rice, steak and broccoli, and drizzle with Japanese BBQ sauce.

changes: Your beef rice bowl favorite, made with the flank steak you have instead of ground beef.
